title: Shared Definitions
description: Common types referenced by every module contract. Owned jointly; changes require agreement from all five module owners.

schema_version.description: SemVer of the contract the producer wrote against. Consumers must reject a major version they do not know.

skill_name.description: Canonical skill label as it appears in SKILL.skill_name. Not free text — must exist in the skill vocabulary.

unit_interval.description: Normalised signal or score in [0,1]. Never a percentage.

requirement_level.description: Derived from the JD's own requirement language, never from model judgement.

provenance.description: Where an observed signal came from, so any Evidence Score can be decomposed back to raw facts.
